name: ANALOGICAL
description: Analogy-making is at the core of human and artificial intelligence and creativity with applications to such diverse tasks as proving mathematical theorems and building mathematical theories, common sense reasoning, learning, language acquisition, and story telling. This paper introduces from first principles an abstract algebraic framework of analogical proportions of the form `$a$ is to $b$ what $c$ is to $d$' in the general setting of universal algebra. This enables us to compare mathematical objects possibly across different domains in a uniform way which is crucial for AI-systems.
reputation: An influential theoretical framework for analogical reasoning, but not a standard large-scale benchmark with broad leaderboard usage.
notes: Primarily a formal/theoretical benchmark or framework rather than a mainstream empirical dataset; task formulation may vary across instantiations.
